aggregate_policy.precondition: A fresh root-approved cix-native-quality-scope-v1 records cache preservation/prune, complete frozen workspace/native identities, and admission of this 600 MB all-new-work cap after accounting for the prepared source snapshot.

non_claims: no full regression suite or release-LTO build
no bridge rebuild, missing-symbol fixture, or platform qualification
no claim that the real-provider positive dispatch fixture exercises a missing-symbol DSO
purpose: Focused PAQ shared-loader qualification on an immutable portable workspace snapshot and real retained providers; not a benchmark or full regression run.
required_observations: complete workspace/native snapshot and provider identities match before and after every phase
cargo fmt --all --check and cix-native --all-targets Clippy -D warnings pass
paq_worker::tests reports a nonzero passed-test count
a fresh target inside the owned work tree produces cix before the real installed-provider dispatch fixture runs
installed_paq_and_jxl_complete_archive_dispatch uses that current cix plus all four retained PAQ bridges and retained JXL bridge
the all-new-work monitor enforces 600 MB across source, target, logs, tmp, and private PAQ root; the shared-work preflight remains within 4 GB

source_freeze.scheduler_action: After archive, Sonar, and fresh capacity admission, root creates exactly one immutable portable workspace snapshot at <work>/source. It includes the source export, workspace Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/EXPORT-MANIFEST.json, and rust/cix-native; root records its complete workspace_files_sha256 and native_files_sha256 maps in the quality-scope record before dispatch.
